title: Safety Fall
description: Gives you a slow falling buff when falling down to prevent lethal fall damage
body:
# 🛡️ Fall Protection

> **Never die from fall damage again!** This datapack automatically prevents lethal fall damage by activating emergency slow falling just in time.

---

## ✨ Features

🎯 **Smart Detection** - Calculates if fall damage would be lethal and activates protection automatically

⚡ **Instant Response** - 0.5 second delay before activation for realistic gameplay

🎮 **Seamless Integration** - Works perfectly with all game mechanics, armor, and enchantments

💬 **Customizable Messages** - Toggle protection notifications on/off with simple commands

🌍 **Multiplayer Ready** - Works perfectly on servers and for all players

---

## 📦 Installation

### Automatic Method (Recommended)

1. Install **[Paxi](https://modrinth.com/mod/paxi)** or another global datapack loader
2. Install this datapack through the Modrinth App
3. Launch Minecraft - the datapack will automatically load in all new worlds!

### Manual Method

1. Download the datapack `.zip` file
2. Create a new world → Click **"Data Packs"**
3. Drag & drop the `.zip` file into the selection screen
4. Click **"Done"** → **"Create New World"**

### For Existing Worlds

1. Open your world folder → `datapacks/`
2. Place the `.zip` file inside
3. In-game: `/reload` or restart the world

---

## 🎮 How It Works

The datapack monitors your fall distance in real-time:

- ✅ Detects when you're falling from a dangerous height (4+ blocks of air below)
- ✅ Waits **0.5 seconds** to ensure you're actually falling
- ✅ Applies **Slow Falling** effect for 2 seconds
- ✅ Automatically deactivates when you land safely

**No configuration needed** - just install and play!

---

## ⚙️ Commands

### Toggle Notification Messages

**Enable Messages:**
```mcfunction
/function fall_protection:message_on
```

**Disable Messages:**
```mcfunction
/function fall_protection:message_off
```

Messages are **enabled by default** for all players.

---

## 🔧 Technical Details

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.11
- **Pack Format:** 94
- **Performance Impact:** Minimal (runs every tick but highly optimized)
- **Compatibility:** Works with all mods, datapacks, and plugins
- **Server-Friendly:** Fully compatible with multiplayer servers

### Detection System

The datapack uses an intelligent air-block detection system:
- Checks for 4+ blocks of air beneath the player
- Uses a tick-based timer (10 ticks = 0.5s delay)
- Applies Slow Falling V (maximum strength) for guaranteed survival
- Automatically clears effects upon landing

---

## ❓ FAQ

**Q: Does this work with armor/enchantments?**  
A: Yes! The datapack activates before damage calculation, so your armor still matters.

**Q: Will I never take fall damage?**  
A: You'll only be protected from **lethal** falls. Small falls still cause normal damage.

**Q: Does this work in multiplayer?**  
A: Absolutely! Works perfectly on servers with multiple players.

**Q: Can I modify the delay time?**  
A: Yes! Edit `check_fall.mcfunction` and change the value in `matches 10..` (10 = 0.5s, 20 = 1s, etc.)

**Q: Does this prevent intentional falls?**  
A: The 0.5s delay allows quick falls to still work while protecting accidental dangerous falls.
